description: This Java class 'ProductFiles' serves as a data transfer object for handling product file uploads in a web admin interface. It encapsulates form data such as a list of uploaded multipart files, associated product, and digital product details, along with validation annotations.

classes.name: ProductFiles
classes.description: A bean class for capturing and validating form data related to product files upload in the admin interface.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the list of MultipartFile objects representing uploaded files.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the list of uploaded files.
